sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
This card was a prize given out at the Huntik National Championships in 2009. From what is known, only 36 were ever made. They were given out as follows: *'''Great Britain National Championship''' - Top 8 competitors *'''Italy National Championship''' - Top 8 competitors *'''Germany National Championship''' - Top 8 competitors *'''Benelux National Championship''' - Top 4 competitors *'''New Zealand National Championship''' - Top 4 competitors *'''Austalia National Championship''' - Top 4 competitors
